banking-economy.title: NBFC credit to gold jewellery, consumer durables grows over 50 pc in Sep: RBI data
banking-economy.summary: In September 2026, non-banking finance companies' credit to gold jewellery and consumer durables surged significantly. Credit for gold jewellery rose by 66.1 per cent to Rs 3.74 lakh crore compared to the previous year. Consumer durables also saw a 54.4 per cent increase in credit, reaching Rs 77,896 crore. Overall, credit growth for NBFCs stood at 15.4 per cent, totaling Rs 61.69 lakh crore.
